overview: The world of Sotha and its mysterious beacon become the focus of a Night Lords attack.
synopsis: The Pharos on Sotha offers the forces of Imperium Secundus a way to connect across a galaxy disrupted by the Ruinstorm. Barabas Dantioch studies and operates the ancient device, while Alexis Polux and the Ultramarines help protect the world around it.
The Night Lords assault Sotha, seeking control of the beacon. The defence draws in soldiers and civilians as Dantioch faces a choice over what the device can be allowed to do in enemy hands.
detailed: Sotha’s strategic importance comes from the Pharos, an ancient installation capable of functions its Imperial operators only partly understand. Dantioch works to use its properties in support of Guilliman’s isolated realm. His friendship with Polux develops across the old boundaries of their Legions.

The Night Lords attack the planet and subject its defenders to a campaign of terror. The battle is experienced at the scale of command decisions and individual survival, with the Ultramarines and the human population forced into desperate resistance.

As the attackers close on the installation, Dantioch refuses to let them secure its power. He overloads the device. The action destroys the immediate enemy threat at an immense personal cost, and Dantioch dies after ensuring that the Pharos cannot be used as intended by the invaders.

The ending follows the release of energy beyond the immediate battle. In the void outside the galaxy, an ancient extragalactic predator registers the signal. The consequence is presented to the reader as something far beyond the knowledge of the surviving defenders.
